meta.title: Three Short Texts for the Island Trip

paragraphs: Three Short Texts for the Island Trip, posted by Lily. Before our trip to a small island, Teacher Kim gave the Explorers three short texts. Each text has facts that we need. Teacher Kim says that the island is a wild place, so we must read the facts first. I copied them here, so you can find the facts too. Can you find the time of the boat?

Text One: The Biology Board. Teacher Kim wrote Text One on the blackboard in the biology room. Macaques are monkeys that live on the island. They eat fruit, leaves, and insects. A group has about twenty monkeys. The monkeys are wild animals, so we must not touch them. A mother monkey carries her baby for the first weeks of its life. Macaques are clever, and they learn from each other. They may steal food from a bag that is open.

Text Two: The Visitor Notice. The pier has a notice for visitors, and Leo wrote it down. The boat to the island leaves at nine o'clock. The last boat returns at four o'clock. The trip takes forty minutes each way. Visitors must come to the pier fifteen minutes before the boat leaves. A ticket for a child costs one hundred baht, and a ticket for an adult costs two hundred baht. Every visitor must wear a life jacket on the boat. The boat has a roof, so the visitors stay dry in the rain. At the bottom of the notice, a red sign says, "Danger: do not feed the monkeys."

Text Three: A Link about Diving. Mia added a link under the post, and it opens a short text about diving. Some animals are very good at diving. A cormorant is a black bird, and it dives for fish. It stays under the water for about thirty seconds. After a dive, a cormorant opens its wings and dries them in the sun. Some penguins dive as deep as five hundred meters. A penguin can stay under the water for ten minutes. A penguin cannot fly, but it swims very well. Mia says that diving is hard work, even for a bird.
On the trip, I will keep my bag closed. After the trip, I will write a diary for the blog. Which text has the price of a ticket? Tell us in a message!
